name: Thought Leadership
description: Share expertise with hook-insights-CTA structure to build authority.

variables.name: hook
variables.description: Opening line — first 210 chars visible before 'see more'. Use stats, contrast, or a bold claim.

variables.name: insight_1
variables.description: First key insight, prefixed with emoji

variables.name: closing
variables.description: End with one closed, take-a-side question, e.g. 'Would you ship it on Friday or wait till Monday?' — not an open 'what's your experience?'.

variables.name: hashtags
variables.description: 1-3 precise hashtags at end. Never more than 3.

tips: Optimal post length: 1300-1600 chars for highest engagement
Be available in golden hour (first 60 min) to reply to comments
Storytelling beats dry information — use personal experience
example_output:
Last month a tool description I wrote broke our LinkedIn MCP server in production.

The model kept calling the wrong endpoint. I'd shipped 14 integrations before this one and assumed the API was the hard part. It wasn't.

I spent two days adding OAuth refresh and structured-output schemas, only to find the real bug was one ambiguous line in the tool's description — the model couldn't tell 'post' from 'repost'. Rewrote that one sentence, and the misfires went to zero.

The API took an afternoon. The description took the rest of the week.

Would you rather debug an OAuth flow or rewrite a tool description?

#MCP #DevTools #AI
